name: Gilthares Firebough
summary: At Northwatch Hold, Gilthares Firebough waits in a tower as Theramore's captive. Once a deckhand on a moonshine run between Ratchet and Booty Bay, he looks for a chance to escape.

sections.title: A Smuggler Behind Bars
sections.body:
Gilthares Firebough is held in a tower at Northwatch Hold. His ship carried illicit cargo between Ratchet and Booty Bay when Theramore's naval forces blasted it apart. Gilthares alone survived. Dragged ashore in chains, he was locked away.

He wears vivid red and has little love for the Alliance zealots who slaughtered his crew. Still, he cares little who helps him break free, so long as they can fight their way down from the ramparts.

faq.answer: Gilthares is an elven deckhand with the Thalo'dan Privateers. Northwatch forces captured him after sinking his merchant vessel off the Barrens coast.

faq.q: Why is he imprisoned in Northwatch Hold?
faq.answer: Gilthares served aboard a transport carrying moonshine between Ratchet and Booty Bay. Theramore soldiers sank the ship, killed the rest of the crew, and imprisoned him at Northwatch Hold with the contraband as a prisoner of war.

faq.q: Is Gilthares a high elf or a blood elf?
aliases: what kind of elf is gilthares
faq.answer: Gilthares is an elf who sails independently, serving neither the Alliance nor Silvermoon's rulers. His red clothing is often associated with the sin'dorei, but he serves privateers rather than a national faction.
The Thalo'dan Privateers are an independent maritime outfit that smuggles goods across the Great Sea. Their ventures include the profitable moonshine run between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

angles.text: Helping Gilthares escape Northwatch strikes a blow against Theramore's aggression along the Barrens coast.
Gilthares is initially indifferent to passersby, but he hates the Alliance sailors who destroyed his vessel and locked him in a cell.
